identity: A primary-school Islamic-education worksheet: 20 multiple-choice / true-false items, one per printed line. Fourteen are sahh-khata (true/false), three are three-way factual choices, three are yujibuni / la yujibuni value-judgement items. The letter ya is written dotless throughout (yursilun, yusalli, yuadhi, yawm) - a scanned-textbook artefact, not a different word.
law: MCQ BANK (section I). Median line is 8 tokens, which normally means LINE MODE and no internal cuts - but checklist v3 PASS 0 names exactly two exceptions to the line law and this is one of them: a word-drill / MCQ list. So I2 + I3 govern: THE STEM ENDS WHERE THE OPTIONS BEGIN, and EVERY OPTION IS ITS OWN UNIT however short. The short-tail brake is suspended. 165 real tokens / 69 units = 2.4 tokens per unit, the same profile as doc_25ed373f8aeb - the document that cost me 33.3 F1 in batch 1 by being read as prose.
reasoning: Where the stem ends was the only real work, and 0h gives the test: stem+sibling must be well formed, and I take the LATEST point where that holds. Three lines end in a dangling function word, the classic colon-in-disguise of I2: @21 fi (kana al-arab yursiluna awladahum li-l-radaa fi | al-madina | al-badiya | al-quds), @162 fi (aradat Amina ... an turdia ibnaha fi | ...), and @128 hum (al-maghdub alayhim hum | al-yahud | al-nasara | al-muslimin). @11 is the same thing one step up: sifat is a dangling idafa head (min sifat | al-munafiq | al-kafir | al-muminn). The three-way numeric items keep their counter with the number - 5 salawat / 6 salawat / 7 salawat and 6 sanawat / 7 sanawat / 8 sanawat are two-token options, not four one-token ones (I3 explicitly allows a two-token option, cf. 1882 m). Same for la yujibuni, which is one option of two tokens opposite yujibuni. On the last line I checked the latest-well-formed rule: min adawat al-kitaba allati waradat fi al-ayat + al-mimhat is well formed, but ...fi al-ayat al-mimhat + al-qalam is not, so the stem ends at al-ayat and there are three siblings (eraser, pen, ruler). I5 also applies: the internal wa in al-fuqara wa al-muhtajin and in afrahihi wa ahzanihi is bare-noun wa and does NOT cut - boundaries go BETWEEN siblings, never inside one. The sahh / khata pair is treated as two separate options on all fourteen true-false items, identically every time (0s: a repeated pattern must be segmented identically).
